Name: Load and Store Address Calculation
objective: Separate effective-address arithmetic from the data transferred by LW and SW.
learning_objective: Separate effective-address arithmetic from the data transferred by LW and SW.
core_conclusion: Both LW and SW add a signed byte offset to rs1; LW copies memory into rd, while SW copies rs2 into memory.

terminology.scope: RV32I aligned word accesses in ordinary memory; byte addresses and signed 12-bit offsets, no exceptional or device behavior.

references.basis: Load and Store Instructions defines EA=rs1+sign-extended offset; loads use rd, stores use rs2.

sources.scope: Load and Store Instructions defines EA=rs1+sign-extended offset; loads use rd, stores use rs2.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Address base exists; destination x5=0; memory word 0x2000=42.
scenes.change: Expand the leading ones to 32 bits while retaining -8; carry base and signed offset into an addition lane.
english_copy: A negative offset moves below the base.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.change: Select only memory row 0x2000; move a 42 token from that row to x5; replace x5=0 with x5=42 on arrival.
scenes.result: Memory retains 42 and x5 becomes 42; address does not get written to x5.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.trigger: Decode the store and add base plus offset.
scenes.change: Move base 0x2008 and offset 4 into the address addition; separately keep 99 as store-data token.
scenes.cause: Decode the store and add base plus offset.
scenes.result: EA is 0x200C; 99 is data, never added to the base.
english_copy: SW uses rs2 as store data.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Store selects 0x200C but has not changed memory.
scenes.change: Carry 99 from x6 into selected memory row, replace its value 0→99 and preserve other rows; show x6 still 99.
english_copy: Same address arithmetic, opposite data direction.

critical_processes.uncertainty: rs2 data changes only selected memory word.
critical_processes.expected_observation: 99 travels from x6 to 0x200C and memory changes 0→99.

prompt:
A 30-second silent English educational animation for a university digital electronics course on Load and Store Address Calculation: sign-extend the twelve-bit -8 displacement and add it to base x1=0x2008 to select address 0x2000; move loaded word 42 from that memory row into x5 while memory retains it, then form store address 0x200C from the same base plus 4 and carry separate x6=99 data to replace only that word while x6 and other memory words remain unchanged.

Use a radial dark background from #142238 through #0d1626 to #070b12 with a 72px grid and a #60a5fa glow; primary #60a5fa marks main fields, registers, or paths, accent #fbbf24 marks carried values and selected quantities, result #34d399 marks completed values or valid selections, and warn #f87171 marks discarded or unavailable work; use Helvetica Neue with Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI, and sans-serif fallbacks, 50px headings at weight 700, 30px body copy, and 21px uppercase kickers with 5px tracking; at 30 fps, slide-up headings 22px over 16 frames from frame 8 and stagger-in copy from frame 20 in 11-frame steps with 12-frame fades and 16px rises; marker-travel forms the signed address over 65 frames and carries load/store payloads in opposite directions; replace x5 at frame 330 and the selected store word at frame 750; provide the Remotion source and course kit with Remotion 4.0.410, React 19.0.0, TypeScript 5.8.2, Node.js, a Chromium render environment, and FFmpeg, with 1920x1080 H264 MP4 output and no audio; exact reproduction on a clean machine has not been verified.
